Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. The bidder shall be a registered manufacturer or authorized dealer/distributor of outdoor fitness / playgr ound equipment, with a valid GST registration and PAN. 2. The bidder shall have successfully supplied and installed outdoor gym equipment in at least thre e (3) si milar projects, each of comparable scope, in India during the last five (5) years. Supporting purchase order s and completion / performance certificates from clients must be submitted. 3. The bidder shall have an Average Annual Turnover (AAT) of not less than ₹2.80 crore for OE Ms and ₹35 lakh for Sellers/Resellers (other than OEMs) in any two (2) of the last three ( 3) financial years. The bidder s hall submit audited balance sheets or a Chartered Accountant (CA )-certified turnover certificate as docum entary evidence in support of this requirement. 4. All equipment offered shall be tested and certified to EN 16630 safety standards. Certificates mus t be i ssued by a recognized International Certifying Body — IPEMA, TÜV, CPSC, or SGS ONLY — and must be verifiable online on the certifying body's official website. Online verification is mandatory. 5. The bidder shall not be blacklisted or debarred by any Central / State Government department, P SU, or autonomous institution as on the date of bid submission. Note: EMD exemption to MSME firms will be granted only if the bidder itself is the MSE /OEM of all the prod ucts offered. If even one of the offered items is not manufactured by the bidder as its own OEM product, th e bidder's MSME status will not be considered for EMD exemption or MSME/MII Purchase Preference.
